description: net's happy-eyeballs defaults as Node 22.22.0's (playwright-core reads them at load): getDefaultAutoSelectFamily / getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout, their setters' checks, the 10 ms floor
argv: const net = require('net'); for (const k of ['getDefaultAutoSelectFamily', 'setDefaultAutoSelectFamily', 'getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout', 'setDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout']) console.log(k, typeof net[k], net[k].length); const t = (l, f) => { try { console.log(l, f()); } catch (e) { console.log(l, e.name, e.code, e.message); } }; t('family', () => net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamily()); t('timeout', () => net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout()); t('set false', () => (net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamily(false), net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamily())); t('set 5', () => (net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout(5), net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout())); t('set 300', () => (net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout(300), net.getDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout())); t('bad family', () => net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamily(1)); t('bad timeout', () => net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout(0)); t('bad timeout type', () => net.setDefaultAutoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout('1'));
